$comment: Competitor and external-product name audit (standing rule; ADR-0001 AI 16; ADR-0002 AI 13). The names live base64-encoded in name-denylist.b64 so that the list itself is not a mention in source. Matches are case-insensitive and word-bounded. Only the connector adapters and the legacy-migration staging adapter may contain protocol facts (table names, URL schemes, format identifiers) of an external system.
